slides.headline: 1) HAND IT YOUR COMMUNITY TO WATCH
slides.body: Community managers charge $3,000 a month and go offline at 5pm. It monitors your community 24/7, answering questions and DM-ing anyone who goes unheard. Prompt: "Watch my community, reply using my FAQ below, and DM anyone unanswered after 2 hours."

slides.headline: 2) MAKE IT YOUR BREAKING NEWS ALARM
slides.body: Social media monitoring tools charge $120 a month and check accounts hourly at best. It scans major AI company X accounts every 15 minutes and sends an alert the moment one posts something big. Prompt: "Check @OpenAI @Google @AnthropicAI on X every 15 mins, alert me the moment any post spikes."
slides.image_prompt: Smartphone face-up on a dark desk, screen overwhelmed by a cascade of red bell symbols and exclamation-mark alert badges arriving in rapid burst — a breaking-news flood in real time. A clock in the background shows 3 AM. No face. Documentary news photo, 35mm, on-camera flash, film grain. Accent: red alert badges against deep charcoal.

slides.headline: 3) PUT IT ON BUG DUTY OVERNIGHT
slides.body: A freelance QA tester charges $80 an hour and stops when you do. It clicks through your apps around the clock, logs every bug, and has the pull requests written before you wake up. Prompt: "Test my app at [URL] overnight, log every broken flow, and draft a pull request with a fix for each."

slides.headline: 4) TURN EVERY POST INTO A NEWSLETTER DRAFT
slides.body: Newsletter writers charge $500 per send. The moment you post anything, it pulls up your last 5 newsletters for voice reference and produces a full draft before you even put your phone down. Prompt: "When I post to X, load my last 5 newsletters for voice match and draft a full newsletter version."
slides.image_prompt: Close on two hands holding a smartphone showing a single camera-icon post symbol, a glowing amber envelope panel appearing automatically beside it — the instant conversion caught mid-frame. Dark home-office background, no face visible. Documentary news photo, 35mm, on-camera flash, film grain. Accent: warm amber panel glow against electric blue phone screen.

slides.headline: 5) BUILD YOUR OWN THUMBNAIL STUDIO
slides.body: Thumbnail designers charge $50 each and take a full day to deliver. It studied your existing thumbnails and now makes new ones in the same style, without you opening a design tool. Prompt: "Study my last 20 thumbnails, extract the style rules, then generate new ones from any title I give you."

slides.headline: 6) CATCH CUSTOMERS BEFORE THEY LEAVE
slides.body: Customer success managers earn $60,000 a year to spot churn before it happens. It checks retention every day, gives you a list of at-risk subscribers, and has personalized emails drafted for your OK. Prompt: "Check my subscriber activity daily, flag anyone inactive 7+ days, and draft a personalized email for each."
